info.title: Orphograph API
info.summary: Anchor a SHA-256 fingerprint to Bitcoin through OpenTimestamps and get a verifiable receipt.
info.description: A receipt proves WHEN a fingerprint existed: that a file or hash existed at a point in time. It does not establish who made it, who owns it, or that it is original, and it is not a notarisation or legal advice. File contents never reach the server: the client computes the SHA-256 and sends only the fingerprint. Verification is free and needs no account. This document covers the single-fingerprint lane an agent uses most; folders and lineage are described in https://orphograph.com/llms.txt.

post.description: Free tier: three anchors per 24 hours per client, no account. Past it, send a Pack claim code (X-Pack-Token), a Standing Order API key (X-Orpho-Api-Key), or pay for this one anchor with x402. x402 runs on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532), the TEST network: test USDC has no value. One x402 authorization buys one anchor; resending an authorization that already bought an anchor is refused with 401. When the resent request is identical to the one that paid, the body names the receipt_id it bought, so a client whose first reply was lost recovers its receipt without paying twice.

parameters.name: X-Pack-Token
parameters.description: Claim code of a credit Pack; consumes one credit.

parameters.name: X-Orpho-Api-Key
parameters.description: API key of an active Standing Order subscription.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 JSON, carrying a signed EIP-3009 authorization for the exact amount named in the 402 challenge. X-PAYMENT is accepted as the legacy header name.

200.description: Anchored. calendars_ok counts the OpenTimestamps calendar servers that accepted the fingerprint; the Bitcoin attestation follows within hours and is visible on /api/verify.

400.description: Invalid body; the error names the field and the fix.

401.description: A credential or x402 authorization was refused. For an authorization that already bought an anchor, the body carries that receipt_id.

402.description: Free-tier limit reached and x402 is armed: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 requirements as base64 JSON; the body repeats them with limit_per_day, retry_after_seconds and a hint.

415.description: POST bodies must be sent as Content-Type: application/json.

429.description: Free-tier limit reached; retry after Retry-After seconds, or use a Pack, a subscription, or x402.

503.description: Anchoring is temporarily unavailable; nothing was charged unless the body says otherwise.

get.summary: Receipt status from the office's record (free, no account).
get.description: Returns calendar attestation counts and, once pinned, btc_pinned_at: the time the office OBSERVED the Bitcoin pin, not the block's own timestamp. This endpoint does not check the chain itself; to do that without Orphograph, run an OpenTimestamps client over the receipt's .ots files (offline verifier: https://orphograph.com/verify/).

404.description: No receipt with that id (private receipts answer the same way to everyone but their owner).

get.summary: Public anchor counts and calendar status.
Plain-text summary of the service for AI readers.

hash_hex.description: SHA-256 of the content, 64 lowercase hex characters, computed by the client.

sha512_hex.description: Optional SHA-512 of the same content, a second digest stored with the receipt.

client_label.description: Optional label of your own choosing. It is shown on the receipt; do not put secrets or personal data in it.

private.description: Subscribers only: keep the receipt out of public lookup.

notify_email.description: Paid anchors only: email the receipt to this address.

c2pa_manifest_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of a C2PA manifest to bind to this receipt; echoed on verify.

metadata.description: Optional small JSON object stored with the receipt.

paths_public.description: Folder anchors only (/api/anchor_folder): publish the manifest's relative paths. Type-checked here and otherwise ignored.

zk_proof.description: Optional zero-knowledge proof that a fixed, published hash-chain procedure produced the output. It does not prove which model ran.

created_at.description: UTC time the office received the fingerprint (ISO 8601).

btc_pinned_at.description: When the office observed the Bitcoin pin; not the block timestamp.
